sections.heading: 1. A back-friendly stroke
lines: ① Start the drive with a strong leg push.
② Hinge from the hips, don't slump.
③ Damper around the middle; smooth strokes.
④ Start short, add 5 minutes a week.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and get checked if…

and needles — stop and get it checked.

caption:
Lulu's new goal is the rowing machine, but after a few sessions his back is feeling it.

The erg is a great full-body workout, but technique matters. Common reasons for a sore back are pulling with the arms first, slumping through the lower back, cranking the damper up and doing too much too soon.

Try this: legs, then body, then arms on the drive. Hinge from the hips with a tall chest, keep the damper around the middle and add about five minutes each week.

Pain spreading into the leg, pins and needles or pain that keeps building is worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
